query: Which failure modes (arrhythmia, severe off-resonance, extreme coil sensitivity loss, contrast-phase variation) must be included as stress-test sets and what minimum example counts per mode are needed?

response.query: Which failure modes (arrhythmia, severe off-resonance, extreme coil sensitivity loss, contrast-phase variation) must be included as stress-test sets and what minimum example counts per mode are needed?
response.answer: Arrhythmia, severe off-resonance, extreme coil sensitivity loss, and contrast-phase variation must be included as stress-test sets; minimum example counts per mode are typically 10 for each failure mode.

A Rule by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services on 11/23/2018. This estimate is based on calculations of primary care physician CEHRT use prior to the changes made to ACO-11 to align with the Quality Payment Program, which became effective for quality reporting for performance year 2017. This estimate is based on calculations of CEHRT use by primary care physicians prior to the changes made to ACO-11 to align with the Quality Payment Program, which became effective for quality reporting for performance year 2017.
